ValidationRule.description: Contract start must be on/after the close date and within 6 months, contract months must be a multiple of 3 (or 1) and cannot cross 5 years.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Contract_Start__c)), OR( Contract_Start__c < CloseDate, Contract_Start__c > ADDMONTHS(CloseDate, 6), AND(NOT(ISBLANK(Contract_Months__c)), OR(AND(MOD(Contract_Months__c, 3) <> 0, Contract_Months__c <> 1), ADDMONTHS(Contract_Start__c, Contract_Months__c) > ADDMONTHS(TODAY(), 60))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Contract Start / Contract Months are inconsistent with the Close Date.
